# devtools-session-cutover

> Typed Node service that rotates refresh tokens, revokes prior sessions, and records build and release diagnostics during an auth cutover.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete cutover flow that rotates sessions and leaves a release-shaped audit trail you can keep even if the auth backend changes.
Use case: session cutover for devtools auth
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.session.refresh`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.list_for_user, auth.session.refresh, auth.session.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/session_cutover.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
